en: Black‑and‑white elevated view over a European riverside town with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century multi‑storey houses lining a curved street. In the middle distance stands a large factory complex with a very tall smokestack. Beyond are terraced hillsides, fields, and a broad river with steep banks on the opposite shore. People and horse‑drawn vehicles are visible on the main street. A narrow handwritten numeric or catalog notation appears along the right film edge.
